'''Rex Jones''' is the eldest child and only son of [[Alex Jones]]. Alex has frequently brought Rex onto InfoWars broadcasts, which has occasionally been covered on [[Knowledge Fight]].

Rex has also been associated with [[Gavin McInnes]] and his media operation<ref>https://www.splcenter.org/hatewatch/2023/02/02/alex-jones-texts-highlight-infowars-overlap-proud-boys</ref>. Rex is associated with the 'news' website, National File. "In leaked texts shared earlier this month by the Southern Poverty Law Center between him(Alex Jones) and well-known Republican operative Roger Stone in 2020, Jones said “off record this is my site” in relation to National File. According to the texts, the site was explicitly funded by Jones’ father David Jones and was meant to give Jones’ son, Rex Jones, more public visibility."<ref>https://gizmodo.com/alex-jones-infowars-national-file-facebook-twitter-1850238082</ref>
